name: Parlem Telecom Companyia de Telecomunicacions, S.A.
summary: Based in Barcelona, Spain, Parlem Telecom Companyia de Telecomunicacions, S.A. functions as a telecommunications provider for both private individuals and businesses throughout Spain. The company's services include essential offerings such as mobile phone plans, internet access, landline services, and television. Beyond these consumer solutions, Parlem Telecom also furnishes specialized options like data circuits, radio communication links, public Wi-Fi access points, data center facilities, telephony switchboards and associated terminals, video security systems, and tools for monitoring and controlling consumption, in addition to its Agile TV platform. The firm was established in 2012.
